question: Who among following was known as the 'extremist leader' during the Freedom Movement of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was known as the **'extremist leader'** due to his radical approach towards gaining independence from British rule.
